verses.1: The words of Moab, king of Masah, who was defeated by his own people.
verses.2: What is the meaning of “ברי” and “בר-ביטני”? And what does “בר-נדרי” mean?
verses.3: Do not give your women their roles and their ways to become queens.
verses.4: Do not be like kings who are cruel and unjust. Do not be like those who exploit others for their own gain.
verses.5: He will not be able to forget his sins, and the judgment of all his children will be changed.
verses.6: Give reward to those who die, and honor to those whose souls are saved.
verses.7: He will sleep and forget his troubles; his toil will be forgotten.
verses.8: Open your mouths, O idols! All the children of Hulof are doomed.
verses.9: Open your mouths to judge fairly, and to enforce justice for the poor and the orphaned.
verses.10: Who can find the fire of life, far from the known circles of the world?
verses.11: Her heart was assured by her husband, and nothing was missing from it.
verses.12: May he be blessed with good things, and no evil, throughout his entire life.
verses.13: She demanded that they be cut into pieces, and she made them into cloth. She did this with great effort.
verses.14: It was like an auctioneer from afar, bringing her meat.
verses.15: And in the middle of the night, she got up and gave food to her household, as well as provisions for her daughters.
verses.16: It was a time of harvest, and they took it from the fruits with their hands. They planted it as a vineyard.
verses.17: She was bound with her own bonds, and she sowed her seeds.
verses.18: It’s good that its fragrance doesn’t fade at night.
verses.19: Her hands were thrown into the fire, and her shoulders were covered with flames.
verses.20: Her hands were extended toward the poor, and her arms were outstretched towards those in need.
verses.21: Do not be afraid of her house, even though it’s covered in snow. For every house in her town is covered with snow for two years.
verses.22: She made six of them, and Argamman became their leader.
verses.23: We know that in the streets, his husband sits with the elders of the land.
verses.24: She made it, then sold it; and the garment was given to the Canaanites.
verses.25: It was dark and cold, and she played for another day.
verses.26: Her mouth opened with wisdom and the law of grace upon her change.
verses.27: She went to her house, but she couldn’t eat the bread of darkness.
verses.28: Her daughters stood up and honored her husband. They praised him.
verses.29: The many daughters made a row, and you stood on all of them.
verses.30: False beauty and ugliness are not worthy of God’s love. A woman who fears Jehovah will be blessed.
verses.31: Give her the fruits of her hands, and let people praise her in the streets for her creations.
